trap.label: misto B
trap.wrong: If I had the money, I would have bought the house.
trap.right: If I had had the money, I would have bought the house.
trap.why: O brasileiro usa if + passado simples para algo passado. Para o 3º tipo (passado irreal), use had + pp.

mcq.q: If it ___ up to me, I would build it. (agora)
If it ___ up to me, I would have built it. (passado)
Misto B: if + past simples, would have + pp: If I ___ rich, I would have helped.

fix.wrong: If I had the money, I would have bought it.
fix.right: If I had had the money, I would have bought it.

fix.wrong: If he is kind, he would have helped.
fix.right: If he were kind, he would have helped.

fix.wrong: If she would be here, we would have won.
fix.right: If she were here, we would have won.

rewrite.prompt: 3º tipo: “I didn’t have the money, so I didn’t buy it.”
rewrite.answer: If I had had the money, I would have bought it.

rewrite.prompt: 2º tipo: “It is not up to me, so I don’t build it.”
rewrite.answer: If it were up to me, I would build it.

rewrite.prompt: Misto B: “He isn’t kind, so he didn’t help.”
rewrite.answer: If he were kind, he would have helped.
